purpose: Trigger-rate evals: measure whether the SKILL.md frontmatter description correctly induces Claude to load docs-context for relevant prompts AND to skip loading for off-topic prompts. Complements evals.json (which tests behavior given the skill is loaded). Refs: agentskills.io optimizing-descriptions.

expectations.decision_signal: agent invokes Skill tool with name=='docs-context' (run.sh --trigger-only checks transcript for this); detection matches the rule used by run.sh main eval mode.

notes: Each prompt is paired with a near-miss counterpart in the opposite list to stress the description's discrimination boundary.
Prompts mix EN and zh-CN to verify both description blocks (SKILL.md + SKILL-CN.md mirror) trigger consistently.
Prompts intentionally DO NOT include the phrases 'load docs' / 'sync docs' / '加载文档' / '同步文档' — those would be explicit triggers, not the implicit-trigger behavior we want to validate.
Should-not-trigger prompts deliberately use overlap keywords (refactor in a generic sense, design in the abstract, etc.) to test discrimination, not pure topical disjointness.
